before: A context menu Paste whose clipboard read the browser refused pasted nothing, also after a copy in the editor.
after: The editor remembers its last copy or cut per window, and a context menu Paste uses it when the read is refused. The paste runs the existing paste command.
reason: The change touches only the local clipboard read and a per-window memory of the editor's own copy. The paste uses the existing paste command, so shared state, operations, and presence data do not change.
